human_owner.summary: Approved in advance by the owner through auto mode; the Claude reviewer decides.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Flexor digitorum profundus and flexor pollicis longus are already scored through wrist flexion at 0.3 and 0.1. The tracer takes the highest action score, so the grip demand cannot raise them to the sustained-grip role these muscles play when holding the bar. This is a tracer limitation, not an authoring error.
The isometric forearm supination holding the palms-up grip is not credited. Its effect would be minor, and omitting it does not materially distort the profile.
non_blocking_findings.suggested_correction: Optionally add radioulnar_joint/supination as an assist in a future revision.

model_reviewer.summary: The definition matches a seated, bilateral, supinated low-pulley cable wrist curl. The frames show the forearms resting on the thighs with the wrist as the only moving joint, and the instructions say the same. Wrist flexion as the single primary action correctly makes flexor carpi radialis and both flexor carpi ulnaris heads the primary movers, with the palmaris longus and finger flexors as synergists. The grip demand covers the bar held in the hands and adds only low-coefficient hand intrinsics. Bilateral laterality, empty one_sided_limbs, open_chain and the wrist_and_grip family are all appropriate. No elbow or shoulder action or demand is needed because the forearms are supported.
